messages:
sara (oncall): not getting pages for PD services since ~09:12 UTC. I saw a PagerDuty -> Slack bridge error in the bridge logs, could be the integration. :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: [AUTO] Received trigger for PD-4528 (runtime-inference-errors) at 2024-10-03T09:12:08Z — attempted notification to on-call but delivery failed (502).

sara (oncall): confirmed — no phone or SMS hit me. I only saw this Slack thread. Anyone on call for infra?

lee (sre): I'm nearby. Checking the bridge cluster now. Saw repeated 502s from the pagerduty webhook -> slack-proxy: `HTTP 502 bad gateway` in the last 6m.

lee (sre): quick log snippet:
```
2024-10-03T09:12:05Z bridge svc: POST /v1/notify -> 502 from slack-proxy (upstream timeout)
2024-10-03T09:12:06Z bridge svc: retry=1 delay=2s
2024-10-03T09:12:08Z bridge svc: POST /v1/notify -> 502 from slack-proxy (conn refused)
```

jordan (eng): any recent deploy to slack-proxy or bridge? I rolled out a config change to slack-proxy yesterday but can roll back.

ado (support): customers are already noticing webhook timeouts in our telemetry. First customer complaint at 09:18 UTC. We should assume some workflows relying on PD -> Slack notifications are impacted.

lee (sre): action plan: 1) roll slack-proxy to previous image (jm-rollout-2024-09-30) if traffic still fails, 2) manually page on-call phone tree, 3) notify CS for customer-impact assessment. Starting (1) now.

sara (oncall): I'm starting manual paging to phone tree. pinging on-call lineage: @jordan (eng) if we need code rollback please ping here.

incident-bot: Incident channel automation check: slack-integration-health = FAIL (last probe 09:14 UTC). Notifying eng-oncall.

jordan (eng): rollback started: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/slack-proxy slack-proxy=registry/redwood/slack-proxy:jm-rollout-2024-09-30`

lee (sre): rollback deployed. health check results: initial 502s cleared, probe at 09:20 UTC succeeded. Will watch for 5m.

ado (support): updating incident timeline for customers: window 09:12-09:20 UTC. Affected features: on-call alerts, webhook-backed integrations for partners X and Y. Raising priority to P1 for notification reliability.

sara (oncall): manual mitigation completed — phone tree reached. No missed escalations after 09:20 UTC. Good catch on the rollback.

jordan (eng): adding temporary alert to detect Slack-proxy 5xx % > 1% over 1m and disable the rolling window rollout automation until we have safe deployment gating.

lee (sre): root cause (prelim): slack-proxy config change introduced a small concurrency bug causing upstream timeouts under burst traffic. Repro steps and minimal reproducer in a sec.

jordan (eng): repro snippet (dev cluster):
```
# produces >50% 502s when burst concurrent=200
ab -n 1000 -c 200 -p payload.json -T application/json http://slack-proxy.dev.internal/v1/notify
```

incident-bot: Post-incident checklist: page engineering lead, create postmortem, tag incident with `automation-failure` and `pagerduty-integration`.

ado (support): I've notified the affected customers with the 8-minute window and next steps. CS lead requested a recording for the postmortem call.

sara (oncall): handing off to lee for next 4 hours. I'll update rotations that I'm OOO for the afternoon. Please keep me in the loop if any follow-up paging automation regressions occur.

lee (sre): taking it — will coordinate with jordan on fix and postmortem. Assigning to `eng-runtime` and `eng-oncall`.

jordan (eng): will prepare a revert + unit test for concurrency paths, and add live-canary gating to avoid rolling full traffic on the same config change.

sara (oncall): thanks team. Quick notes for postmortem: why automation failed to page (bridge retried but slack-proxy 502 -> PagerDuty recorded failures), customer impact window, manual mitigations and timeline, and action items: tighter deploy gating, alert on PD->Slack failures, and runbook updates to manual-page flow.

lee (sre): capturing action items in the incident doc, creating postmortem draft and will tag owners.

pagerduty-bot: [AUTO] Incident PD-4528 resolved at 2024-10-03T09:21:34Z (notifications restored).

sara (oncall): marking this thread resolved from on-call perspective. Please escalate if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
